title: Decoding in Geometry: Alleviating Embedding-Space Crowding for Complex Reasoning
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical aspects of autoregressive decoding in Large Language Models, specifically addressing a geometric phenomenon called 'embedding-space crowding.' It evaluates its proposed method (CraEG) using mathematical reasoning benchmarks (AIME and HMMT). It contains a standard 'Impact Statement' regarding societal implications and misuse, but it does not evaluate or benchmark topics related to faith, religion, or ethics.
